newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB to upgrade Swedish nuke plant.
newsitem.headline: ABB to upgrade Swedish nuke plant.

text.p: ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it had received an order worth $85 million to modernise Oskarshamn 1 nuclear power plant on the south-east coast of Sweden.

The order was placed by OKG AG in Oskarshamn, a subsidiary of privately-owned Swedish power utility Sydkraft AB, and covers the upgrading of the plant's turbines and reactor control system, ABB said in a statement.
Oskarshamn 1 is the oldest nuclear power plant and was commissioned in 1971. The modernisation programme is scheduled for completion in 1999.

ABB said it would install the latest generation of electrical and control equipment, designed for both Boiling Water Reactors (BWRs) and Pressurised Water Reactors (PWRs) and modernise the main control room.
It will also replace the plant's high-pressure steam turbine and deliver six new low-pressure turbines.
The upgrade will improve the plant's efficiency and reliability and boost output by 15 megawatts.
